description: Every product master record must have a unique, non-null identifier.
Every sellable SKU must have a unique, non-null identifier.
Supplier master records must be unique and non-null.
Every SKU must reference a product that exists in the product master.
Every store must be assigned to a warehouse that exists in the warehouse master.
Every purchase order must reference a SKU that exists in the SKU master.
Product unit cost must be populated to support margin and inventory valuation reporting.
Daily sales revenue must be populated for every recorded transaction line.
Daily units sold per store-SKU should stay within a plausible single-day operating range.
On-hand inventory cannot be physically negative; negative values indicate a system synchronisation defect.
Unit price must fall within a plausible retail price band.
